baseline.preserve: J372 accepted UI, 65 eligible offers and cluster applicability, 16 held exclusions, 30 reference SKUs, no unsupported badges

instructions: Inspect source vs accepted served bundle before editing; build from the accepted J372 baseline without reverting to an old staging snapshot.
Keep existing user edits; isolate J373 candidate and synchronize all staging assets with a manifest. Do not overwrite sealed release artifacts.
The existing :4176 server injects search.css/search.js: audit/remove collisions in candidate and bind the receipt to actual HTTP-served bytes, not an unrelated folder.
Use Vanilla JS client-side; keep existing functionalities working. Verify any root/public mirrors involved in staging serve identical candidate bytes.

requirements: Place 'Bạn đang ở quán nào?' brand/branch combobox directly below header, above hero; search accent-insensitively using preloaded local index.
Selection opens accessible compact sheet with 3 numbered steps: student/member eligibility, wallet/payment offer, combo/order choice.

Compute cheapest only among documented compatible options for selected branch, date, basket and customer eligibility; show caps/min spend/exclusions and evidence links. No unsupported stacking or promise of a global cheapest price.
Missing data leaves a usable step with 'Hỏi nhân viên' or 'Chưa có thông tin'; do not invent Phê La or other offers from mandate examples.
100 actual input/selection interactions: input-to-result-DOM p95 <50ms; separately measure next paint and exclude sheet animation from filtering budget.
1–30 local participant aliases, 1–100 items; integer VND totals, qty 1–99; assign each line to one or multiple participants. Shared fees split across all current participants.

Allocate each shared integer total with quotient/remainder in stable participant-ID order. Sum allocations exactly equals all line totals plus fees. Recompute after edits/deletion; unresolved assignments block settlement.
Use safe integer validation and maximum total 1000000000 VND; reject decimals, negatives, NaN, zero people and out-of-range quantities; show preview before generating QR.
User enters receiving bank/BIN, account and optional display name; preserve account as a string including leading zeros. Confirm recipient and exact per-person amount before QR.
Generate VietQR locally using official current format/bank directory verified by executor with source/version/date. Do not use a remote QR image URL containing account details.

Decode generated payload and check recipient, amount, checksum and actual bank-app recognition with consented test recipient; no funds transfer needed. An untested bank compatibility result remains NOT_TESTED.
No invented bank/recipient, no auto-transfer, no confirmation of paid status from QR creation. Zero-share participants show 0 VND and no payment QR.
Branch details show Wi-Fi, sockets, air conditioning, motorcycle parking and return bus information as independently sourced fields.

Publish Wi-Fi only when venue authorizes guest disclosure or public guest signage supports it; store branch ID, source capture SHA256, observed_at, checked_at, validity and permitted disclosure. Expired or unknown data displays unavailable.

Bus display distinguishes published timetable from live arrival. Show stop, route, direction and service date from official source; no 'nearest departure' realtime claim without corresponding live feed.
Support selected campus/branch/map pin as origin; optional browser geolocation only after tapping a clearly labeled action, keep coordinates in RAM.

500m default uses geodesic distance and states 'Trong bán kính 500m'; do not label 500m as three-minute walk. Walking distance/time requires routed pedestrian evidence; list location accuracy when relevant.
Facilities without coordinates are not eligible for numeric proximity ranking; denied GPS or no nearby results retains manual origin selection.

privacy.storage: RAM only for names, account, amounts and coordinates; clear on explicit reset/end session and reload
privacy.telemetry: No sensitive values in URL, localStorage, logs, analytics or external requests
privacy.external_actions: Open source/map links only on explicit tap; disclose when opening an external map shares chosen location

checks: Keyboard combobox and sheet focus trap/Escape/return focus, touch targets >=44px, AA contrast, zoom200%, no page overflow
Arithmetic: 100000/3 = 33334+33333+33333; qty and multi-owner items, odd shared fee, participant removal, invalid input, exact conservation
Decode QR independently; recipient leading zeros and Unicode memo, amount and checksum; bank-app compatibility proof or explicit NOT_TESTED
500m threshold boundary tests, missing coordinates, GPS denied/inaccurate, empty brand, expired offer, unknown Wi-Fi/bus
Capture console/page errors and sensitive-data network/storage audit using synthetic test data
Receipt includes actual served hashes, screenshots, runner command/environment, per-test PASS/FAIL/NOT_TESTED, measured timings and raw evidence paths; no blanket PASS for missing evidence
gemini_scenarios: At cafe: choose branch, read applicable payment options and guest utilities
At restaurant: 3 people share one item, two individual items and an odd shared fee; inspect each QR amount
Choose campus origin and find known facilities within 500m; try no GPS and no bus data
